info.title: Medical Cabinet API
info.description: Visitors, patient notes, appointments and reminder settings. Replace REGION, ACCOUNT_ID, FUNCTION_NAME, COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID and COGNITO_CLIENT_ID before importing.

get.summary: List visitors, or look one up by email (staff)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search name, email or phone (case-insensitive substring); limit applies, default 25

delete.summary: Delete a visitor and their patient record (staff)

get.summary: List appointments by day range or by visitor (staff)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day, max 62 days after from

patch.summary: Reschedule, edit, or mark completed / no_show (staff)

get.summary: Free appointment start times within working hours (staff)
Message texts: built-in defaults and customised overrides (staff)

put.summary: Replace the customised message texts (admin). Blank fields fall back to the built-in text

post.summary: Render one message with sample data, exactly as a visitor receives it. Stores nothing (staff)
Re-plan reminders of all future appointments (admin)

AppointmentPatch.description: Change either start_at or status, not both

channel.description: whatsapp only appears in old log rows

working_hours.description: Keys mon..sun; missing or empty = closed. Default Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00

TemplateFields.description: Placeholders allowed: {name} {cabinet} {date} {time} {phone}. Any other curly brace is rejected.

MessageOverrides.description: kind -> language -> fields. Kinds: confirmation, reminder, rescheduled, cancelled. Languages: en, ro

defaults.description: kind -> language -> the three built-in texts

sms_text.description: As sent: accents folded to plain letters
